reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, xbuffer owns data plus end/size/init_size metadata; init starts empty and add_byte acquires ecalloc storage when capacity is exhausted.
owner_creation.invariant: A live xbuffer needs one coherent allocation descriptor.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, xbuf_char_data returns a raw borrowed pointer, while Copy/Clone can duplicate the owning descriptor; add_data retains its source pointer across calls that may grow the destination.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Raw aliases must be retired before buffer growth.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, calls are direct ecalloc/memcpy/free and an optional fault hook; there is no registered callback that can extend a slice lifetime.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct copy calls do not validate source ownership.

invalidation.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, growth frees old data at 73; a source pointer into that same allocation in add_data can then be stale on the next loop iteration.
invalidation.invariant: Self-source growth is a recorded alias hazard.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, size is assigned before overflow handling and allocation, and set resets dst before copying src; these are not failure-preserving staged updates.
mutation_commit.invariant: Existing bytes are not protected by a transactional replacement.

release_pair.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, deinit pairs ecalloc with free and resets fields, but copied descriptors or repeated initialization of a live owner can invalidate that single-release contract.
release_pair.invariant: Only one descriptor may release each allocation.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, reserve/size failure calls out_of_memory; capacity can already differ from the still-live old allocation when cleanup runs.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error cleanup must account for precommitted capacity metadata.

signals_handoff.analysis: In src/xbuf.rs, the C API has raw mutable callers and no reentry guard; allocation or deinit from interrupted paths cannot be approved as a safe owner handoff.
limitations: This review records source-level raw owner, self-alias and commit-order hazards; no new runtime reproduction or product fix is claimed.
